query:
UPDATE course_lessons SET content = REPLACE(content, '| Symbol Type | Schematic Identifier | Industrial Application |
|---|---|---|
| Standard (1N400x series) | Triangle + straight bar | Bridge rectifiers, freewheeling protection |
| Zener | Triangle + bent/angled bar ends | Voltage regulation, overvoltage clamping |
| Schottky | Triangle + hooked/curved bar | High-frequency switching supplies, low-loss rectification |
| LED | Triangle + bar + arrows outward | Indicator lights, optocoupler inputs |
| TVS (bidirectional) | Back-to-back triangles | Transient suppression on I/O cards |', '| Symbol Type | Schematic Identifier | Industrial Application | How to Identify on Print |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Rectifier | Triangle + straight bar | Bridge rectifiers, freewheeling protection | Plain triangle-bar, often labeled CR or D |
| Zener | Triangle + bent/angled bar ends | Voltage regulation, overvoltage clamping | Bar has small bends at each end (like a Z) |
| Schottky | Triangle + hooked/curved bar | High-frequency switching, low-loss rectification | Bar curves inward at ends (like parentheses) |
| LED | Triangle + bar + two arrows pointing outward | Panel indicators, optocoupler inputs | Small arrows radiating away from the junction |
| Photodiode | Triangle + bar + two arrows pointing inward | Optocouplers, light sensors | Small arrows pointing toward the junction |
| TVS (bidirectional) | Back-to-back triangles sharing a bar | Transient suppression on I/O cards | Two triangles facing each other |
| Fast Recovery | Triangle + straight bar (same as standard) | Switch-mode power supplies | Identical to standard; identified by part number only |
| Power Freewheeling | Triangle + straight bar (heavy lines) | VFD/servo IGBT protection | Same symbol but drawn with thicker lines or boxed |
| Bridge Rectifier | Four diodes in diamond arrangement | AC-to-DC conversion | Diamond shape with AC input top/bottom, DC output left/right |') WHERE id = 60013;
